sourceMaterials.title: Condition Summary
sourceMaterials.verification: third-party transcription/index; not independently verified against original 3.0 SRD

sourceEditionDifferences.name: Cowering
sourceEditionDifferences.edition3e: Drops held gear, cannot act; enemies gain +2 on attacks and target loses Dexterity AC.
sourceEditionDifferences.edition35e: Cannot act, loses Dexterity AC, takes -2 AC; does not explicitly drop gear.
sourceEditionDifferences.nativeDecision: Preserve 3.5 defensive representation and no gear-drop requirement; Panicked explicitly drops gear.

sourceEditionDifferences.name: Panicked
sourceEditionDifferences.edition3e: 50% chance to drop held items; random flight; -2 on saves; cornered creature cowers.
sourceEditionDifferences.edition35e: Always drops held items; fastest flight; -2 on saving throws, skills and ability checks; cornered creature cowers.
sourceEditionDifferences.nativeDecision: Use 3.5 full-drop and penalties; preserve escape-only actions without granting free additional Actions.

sourceEditionDifferences.name: Shaken
sourceEditionDifferences.edition3e: -2 morale penalty to attacks, checks and saving throws.
sourceEditionDifferences.edition35e: -2 attacks, saves, skill checks and ability checks.
sourceEditionDifferences.nativeDecision: Single -2 native modifier across those roll types, with no redundant -2 from two fear-family conditions.

sourceEditionDifferences.name: Frightened
sourceEditionDifferences.nativeExisting: Line-of-sight Disadvantage on ability checks/attacks and no willing approach; not forced flight.
sourceEditionDifferences.nativeDecision: Existing approved native Frightened stays unchanged; no mandatory 3.x flight imported.

sourceEditionDifferences.name: Fear escalation
sourceEditionDifferences.edition35e: Additional fear effects may elevate Shaken to Frightened or Panicked.
sourceEditionDifferences.nativeDecision: Do not activate automatic escalation pending owner reconciliation, especially because it would change the scope of approved Frightened.

decisions.description: Separate lower-severity fear condition with -2 attacks, saves, skills and ability checks.
Mandatory flight, held-item drop, no unrelated activities; cornered invokes Cowering.
Frozen, cannot act or move, denies positive Dexterity/dodge AC, -2 AC. No implicit Helpless or Concentration loss.
No forced flight or additional numerical penalty added to previously approved Frightened.
3.5e escalation rules documented but not enabled automatically.

provenanceAndRights: Only new paraphrased native mechanics are stored. If historical SRD source passages are imported, retain original OGL provenance separate from the 5.x CC BY materials.
